description: MCP server for tvsubtitles.net. Search TV series, read a season's subtitle coverage and one record, with the page to download it. No API key required.

tool_signatures.name: get_subtitle
tool_signatures.description: Read one record, with its release and the page to download it.

id.description: A subtitle id from list_subtitles. The site answers an id it does not hold by sending the reader to its front page, which this reports as an absence.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A subtitle id from list_subtitles. The site answers an id it does not hold by sending the reader to its front page, which this reports as an absence.

tool_signatures.name: list_languages
tool_signatures.description: List the languages the catalogue holds, or the ones one show holds.

id.description: A show id from search_titles, to read what that show holds rather than what the catalogue does. Left out, the whole catalogue's languages come back.

season.description: Which season to measure a show's languages over. Left out, the newest season is read. Ignored without 'id', because the catalogue has no season.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A show id from search_titles, to read what that show holds rather than what the catalogue does. Left out, the whole catalogue's languages come back.

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Which season to measure a show's languages over. Left out, the newest season is read. Ignored without 'id', because the catalogue has no season.

tool_signatures.name: list_subtitles
tool_signatures.description: Read a season's language coverage, or one episode's subtitle records.

id.description: A show id from search_titles. The site answers an id it does not hold with a page.

limit.description: Rows to render, 40 by default and 200 at most.

season.description: Leave it out to read the newest season. The answer states which season it read.

episode.description: Name an episode to read its subtitle records rather than the season's coverage.

language.description: A language from list_languages, by its name, the site's two-letter code, or its BCP 47 tag. Left out, every language comes back.

parameters.name: episode
parameters.description: Name an episode to read its subtitle records rather than the season's coverage.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A show id from search_titles. The site answers an id it does not hold with a page.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: A language from list_languages, by its name, the site's two-letter code, or its BCP 47 tag. Left out, every language comes back.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows to render, 40 by default and 200 at most.

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Leave it out to read the newest season. The answer states which season it read.

tool_signatures.name: search_titles
tool_signatures.description: Find a television series by name.

year.description: Keep only shows whose published years cover this one. When that leaves nothing, the search is reported without it and a note says the year was set aside.

limit.description: Rows to render, 20 by default and 100 at most.

query.description: The name of a series, or part of one. The site matches on the name alone.

media_type.description: 'tv' or 'any' both search the catalogue, which holds television only. 'movie' is refused, because answering it with an empty list would report an absence this site cannot establish.

with_counts.description: Read each row's subtitle, episode and season counts from the site's catalogue index, which costs one further request over a page of several hundred kilobytes. Each figure counts the whole show rather than this search, each is read on its own, and a cell the index leaves empty keeps a null.
